forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Break cycles by moving the shared rule to src/shared/ or the renderer's shared/lib/, or keep the dependency in one direction (Electron layout).

forbidden.name: renderer-no-node
forbidden.comment: Window code runs in a browser page without Node or Electron; ask the main process through the API on window that src/preload/ sets up (Electron layout).

forbidden.name: renderer-no-electron
forbidden.comment: Window code runs in a browser page without Node or Electron; ask the main process through the API on window that src/preload/ sets up (Electron layout).

forbidden.name: renderer-own-code
forbidden.comment: Window code takes nothing from the main process or the preload script; what both sides need belongs in src/shared/ (Electron layout).

forbidden.name: contract-pure-core
forbidden.comment: All three parts load src/shared/, so it holds types, constants and guards only: no Node built-in (Electron layout).

forbidden.name: contract-pure-path
forbidden.comment: All three parts load src/shared/, so it holds types, constants and guards only: no Electron, no React, and nothing from the three parts (Electron layout).

forbidden.name: main-no-renderer
forbidden.comment: The main process and the preload script run outside the page; they take no window code and no React (Electron layout).

forbidden.name: preload-bridge-only
forbidden.comment: A preload script is the bridge and nothing more: it imports electron and the contract in src/shared/ (Electron layout).

forbidden.name: module-public-api
forbidden.comment: Import another renderer module through its index.ts; keep internal imports inside their own module (Electron layout).

forbidden.name: shared-not-modules
forbidden.comment: Code in the renderer's shared/ is used by every module and may import none; the code that needs a module belongs in src/renderer/src/modules/<module>/ (Electron layout).

forbidden.name: domain-pure-path
forbidden.comment: A domain/ rule is plain TypeScript; React belongs in the module's components/ or hooks/ (Electron layout).

forbidden.name: not-to-test
forbidden.comment: Keep test fixtures and assertions in colocated *.test.ts(x) files; move reusable production logic to domain/ or src/shared/ (Electron layout).
